Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full trade-in estimate payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Your trade-in estimate","vehicle":{"name":"2021 Midsize SUV","detail":"42,300 mi · Good condition","imageUrl":"","initials":"SV"},"currency":"USD","estimate":18400,"low":16900,"high":19800,"offerText":"Instant offer good for 7 days","factors":[{"label":"Mileage","detail":"42,300 mi — below average","impact":"positive"},{"label":"Condition","detail":"Good","impact":"neutral"},{"label":"Market demand","detail":"High for this trim","impact":"positive"}],"submitText":"Apply to a purchase","submitValue":"I'd like to apply my trade-in toward a purchase","secondaryText":"Book an appraisal","secondaryValue":"I'd like to book an in-person appraisal"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Your trade-in estimate'.
- 'vehicle' (object, optional): { 'name' (string, REQUIRED — the vehicle being traded); 'detail' (string, optional — one line, e.g. mileage + condition); 'imageUrl' (string, optional — falls back to initials if it fails to load); 'initials' (string, optional — 1-2 letters) }.
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code, default USD.
- 'estimate' (number, REQUIRED): the estimated trade-in value, shown large. If omitted the card shows sample data.
- 'low' (number, optional): low end of the value range. Defaults to estimate * 0.9.
- 'high' (number, optional): high end of the value range. Defaults to estimate * 1.1. The card draws a range bar from low to high with a marker at 'estimate'.
- 'offerText' (string, optional): a short instant-offer callout, e.g. 'Instant offer good for 7 days'.
- 'factors' (array, optional): each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED); 'detail' (string, optional — one short line); 'impact' (string, optional — one of positive | neutral | negative; drives the row's up/down glyph + color) }.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label. 'submitValue' (string, optional): the message sent back when tapped (defaults to submitText).
- 'secondaryText' (string, optional): a secondary ghost-button label. 'secondaryValue' (string, optional): its sent-back message.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
